venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Saturday 1/10.** Raucous night with lots of round-for-round tables thanks to well-timed rounds; James and Bowen got great flow on busy tickets. Guests were funny and chatty (Gospel regulars, theater dramaturgs, FIRE-sector bros, Caribbean vacationers). Small lull ~10:30, then a massive last call. Breakage: 2 DOF and a pilsner (guest Collins). Top sellers: Fries, Thunderball, Revenant. Kitchen: believed to be the highest food sales since COVID; family meal appreciated. Door: busy Saturday with only small waitlist lulls, rain pushing bar-hoppers in; back-to-back large parties and 59 covers to start; Ellis removed a couple from the bathroom; Happy Birthday Thomas. No no-shows. Repairs: Service 1 tap reader broke.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Saturday 1/10.** Marquee busy from the jump, room nearly full with a full bar, another big turn around 9 and a growing waitlist; busy until ~11. Garden used to hold guests for a round or two while waiting for seats; closed naturally at 11. Last guests arrived around midnight; all closed out on their own by 1am with no last call; door closed 1:15. Comps include a $97 walk-out: wrong bar tab closed, a payment mistakenly deleted, guest left before MOD could fix. Kitchen: ~10% of sales; one chicken order cancelled after a long ticket time and service recovery on oysters; a second set of hands is needed on weekends, especially dish. MOD: Josh / Cory.
